'''K-2G1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that sold various goods in the [[Thul Palace]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
